title: Finite sums of distinguished triangles in a pre-triangulated category
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a pre-triangulated category [def-weil-triangulated-category], let $J$ be a finite set (possibly empty), and for each $j\in J$ let $X_j\xrightarrow{u_j}Y_j\xrightarrow{v_j}Z_j\xrightarrow{w_j}X_j[1]$ be a distinguished triangle. Then the componentwise finite biproduct triangle $\bigoplus_j X_j\xrightarrow{\oplus u_j}\bigoplus_j Y_j\xrightarrow{\oplus v_j}\bigoplus_j Z_j\xrightarrow{\oplus w_j}(\bigoplus_j X_j)[1]$ is distinguished, where its last arrow uses the canonical additive-shift identification $\bigoplus_j X_j[1]\cong(\bigoplus_j X_j)[1]$.
